steps.analyst_reply: {"root_cause": "The single holistic question forces a paralegal/attorney choice on every text, and it fails in two recurring ways: bios with no legal content at all (guitar, hypnosis, comedy, theater, fiction) get answered 'paralegal' even though the pool is ~86% attorney, and bios containing the keyword 'paralegal' (a senior paralegal who later earned a J.D.; a bar member with 'paralegal duties') get classified by the keyword instead of the person's actual current role and credentials. The label is really decided by a chain the scorecard cannot represent with one feature: is there legal content at all, does the person hold attorney credentials or practice law, and is their current role explicitly paralegal/legal-assistant.", "add_elements": [{"key": "mentions_legal_work", "question_type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the text mention the person working in law or the legal field, such as at a law firm, court, bar, or legal organization, or studying or training in law?", "criteria": null}, {"key": "attorney_credentials", "question_type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the text indicate the person is qualified or working as an attorney, for example by mentioning a law degree such as a J.D., admission to a bar, a license to practice law, or that they practice law or represent clients?", "criteria": null}, {"key": "current_paralegal_role", "question_type": "noul", "instructions": "Does the text describe the person's current job as being a paralegal or legal assistant, for example by calling them a paralegal, mentioning a paralegal certificate or paralegal program, or saying they assist or support attorneys in their work?", "criteria": null}], "retire_elements": [], "reword_elements": []}
